test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. **

The defendant's lawyer argued that his past offense were ______ to this case.
solution:
The correct answer to fill in the blank is option 4, "**irrelevant**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The defendant's lawyer argued that his past offenses were irrelevant to this case.
 
• This means that the lawyer believed that the past offenses did not have any bearing on the current case and should not be considered by the court.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In legal terms, evidence that is not relevant to the case at hand is generally not admissible in court.
 
• The lawyer may have argued that bringing up the defendant's past offenses would be prejudicial and could unfairly influence the jury's decision.
 
• It is important for lawyers to carefully consider what evidence they present in court and how it relates to the case they are arguing."
